title: West Bromwich Albion and QPR Face Off at the Top of the Championship
seoTitle: West Brom vs QPR: Championship Leaders Clash
subtitle: Battle at The Hawthorns between the isolated leader and fourth-placed team, with significant absences
excerpt: West Brom hosts Queens Park Rangers this Saturday, September 12th, in a key Championship clash. The match could define the leaders' run, despite significant injuries.
author: Daniele Morais
contentHtml:
The direct clash between West Bromwich Albion and Queens Park Rangers, scheduled for Saturday, September 12th, has garnered attention as it puts the Championship leadership and a playoff spot on the line. The duel takes place at The Hawthorns, West Brom's stadium, bringing together two teams with solid campaigns, yet marked by significant absences.

Table Position and Recent Form

West Bromwich Albion arrives as the clear leader, with 13 points from six rounds, bolstered by four wins in their last five games. Queens Park Rangers sits in fourth position, close to the playoff zone, accumulating two wins and two draws in their last five matches.

Absences That Could Change the Scenario

On the Baggies' side, Brayann Pereira's suspension and injuries to Mikey Johnston, Jayson Molumby, Conor Townsend, and Nolan Galves leave coach James Morrison with limited options, especially at right-back. QPR faces an even more critical situation: Tariq Lamptey, Jimmy Dunne, Ilias Chair, Richard Kone, Karamoko Dembélé, and Koki Saito are doubtful or out, compromising both defense and attack.

Betting Odds

The betting market indicates West Brom as favorites, with win odds at 2.10. A draw is priced at 3.30, and an away win at 3.30. The total goals market has over/under 2.5 with odds of 1.80 for the over and 2.00 for the under. Both teams to score has odds of 1.66, while 'no' pays 12.50.

Head-to-Head History

The head-to-head record heavily favors West Bromwich Albion, who have won 15 of the 28 clashes against Queens Park Rangers. This historical superiority reinforces the home advantage and puts pressure on the visitors, who are already struggling to field an effective attack due to injuries.

What to Expect from the Match

With West Brom looking to consolidate their leadership and QPR fighting for a playoff spot, the duel promises to be intense. The host's absences at right-back could open up spaces for the visiting attack, although history and home advantage still favor the Baggies. The result, besides impacting the table, could influence both teams' strategies in the upcoming Championship rounds.
